landingPage.title: Survey Designer
landingPage.heroSubtitle: Survey Designer is the go-to collaboration tool for teams who want to build standardized, multi-lingual questionnaires that align with WFP codebooks and deploy to ODK-based tools.
landingPage.stat1Label: Years of proven experience in survey design and data collection.
landingPage.stat2Label: Countries using WFP survey tools and standards.
landingPage.stat3Label: Surveys designed and deployed with WFP methodologies.
landingPage.featuresIntro: Survey Designer streamlines how WFP teams design, review, and deploy surveys across contexts and countries.
landingPage.feature1Text: Use WFP naming conventions and codebooks while tailoring surveys to the needs of each operation.
landingPage.feature2Text: Export XLSForm files or push directly to ODK-based platforms such as MoDa and Kobo.
landingPage.feature3Text: Work with colleagues on shared projects, keeping survey versions aligned and auditable.
landingPage.feature4Text: Apply structured modules and indicators to reduce errors and improve data comparability.
landingPage.feature5Text: Support technical review and sign-off processes so questionnaires are ready before field deployment.
landingPage.feature6Text: Capture context, assumptions, and versions so future teams understand how and why surveys were designed.
